name: checkout-explorers
purpose: Try the checkout flow of a small online shop the way a real shopper would, and report anything that goes wrong.

device.detail: Small screen, thumb typing, sometimes on a train with a weak signal.

patience.detail: Leaves if a step takes more than a few seconds or asks for anything twice.
Will retry, go back, and try again a different way.

tech_comfort.detail: Unsure what a field wants; pastes things in odd formats.
Uses the back button, autofill, password managers and keyboard shortcuts.

intent.detail: Shipping to a different address than billing.
Adds items, removes them, changes quantities, may abandon.

found_problem.prompt: true if anything went wrong, confused you or blocked you

severity.prompt: how bad it would be for a real shopper

what_happened.prompt: what you did and what you saw, in your own words

repro_steps.prompt: the exact steps to make it happen again, or empty

would_block_release.prompt: true if you think the shop should not launch with this
